🚨| 𝐑𝐈𝐕𝐀𝐋 𝐖𝐀𝐓𝐂𝐇: Real Madrid's APPEAL regarding Vincius Jr's suspension has been REJECTED by the RFEF. He will remain suspended for 4 games and will MISS El Clásico. ⚪❌
📲 | Lamine on IG:
🚨 Hansi Flick's press-conference ahead of tomorrow's league match against Real Betis, follow live on our page.

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Raphinha's return? If you ask him, he’d say he’s ready. But we want to take things step by step. He’s making good progress, but we have a lot of matches and need to manage his recovery carefully. The same goes for Frenkie. The good news is they're BOTH AVAILABLE.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Frenkie de Jong? He’s a TOP player. I’m happy to have him back. He gives us another option, and he’s READY to play some minutes.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Real Betis have won all their home games and are doing well in the Champions League. We’re facing a team with fantastic players, especially in attack. Tomorrow, we’ll have to defend very well.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on resting Lamine Yamal: “It’s not so easy to answer. He’s Lamine, he’s a special player. The most important thing for him is that he enjoys playing football, and right now, that’s the case. I don’t want to interrupt that, but I know we have to manage his minutes.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on Frenkie playing as a centre-back: “It’s not something we’ve trained extensively. He’s very focused and convinced that he can show how good he is. He’s a top player. We also have a lot of quality on the bench, and everyone must give 100%.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on Alejandro Balde: “It’s not easy for him, but he’s training very well. We have Xavi and João, and they’re both performing at a very high level. Alejandro is doing his job, and I’m happy with what I have.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on Gavi: “He was sad about not being called up to the national team. He’s very professional, and I can see that he wants to improve every day. His intensity and concentration are at a good level. He’s the heart of this team, a top player.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on Abde: “He’s a fantastic player. I’m impressed by him. I like the way he plays and his confidence in one-on-one situations. He scored, and I can only say that he’s an incredible player.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “We haven't tried Frenkie de Jong much in the CB position. It has happened in certain situations during training, especially in small-sided games like five-a-side, where he has sometimes played in the defensive line.

What I see from Frenkie in training is GREAT focus and a strong determination to prove his ability and show how good he is, which is very positive. As I’ve said before, he’s a TOP player, and having him gives us another option, which makes me happy.

Of course, I have to manage this situation with all the players, and it’s not an easy task. However, I’d much rather have this many options than find myself short of players and have to look for someone who can step in. Nobody can relax or feel too comfortable. Everyone must give 100% and remain fully focused.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “What I want from Fermín is exactly what I saw in his goal in Turkey: those late runs into the box. It’s incredible to have him and Dani Olmo, who is struggling a little more in front of goal at the moment.” #fcblive

🚨 Which player was your first pick in your UCL Fantasy Team?

Osimhen: “Lamine”

David Raya: “Pedri”

Gabri Viega: “Lamine and Pedri”
